title: Jordan of Skywatchers shown a sphere in the GATE program

tellings.quote: When he was involved in the gate program as a late teen, uh, intelligence or military brass and and suits and, you know, eggghheads brought in a case, opened it up, and there was the same exact sphere.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, of a group called Skywatchers, says that as a late teen in something called the GATE program, which the telling does not describe, military brass, men in suits and scientists brought in a case, opened it, and showed him a sphere, "the same exact sphere" he had seen elsewhere. A man who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this as Jose told it to him. It would mean officials already had in hand the kind of object Jose had seen.
